summary: Frontend-only verification of the Transactions drill-down rewrite. All 14 review scenarios PASS on 420x900 mobile viewport. filter-ALL is gone; only SELL + BUY chips render in that exact DOM order; SELL is active by default (bg-[#FF007A]) and BUY is inactive (bg-white/5, text-#8B9BB4). On /transactions?date=2026-07-02 the API returns 13 rows (9 SELL + 4 BUY) — SELL view shows exactly 9 rows, BUY view shows exactly 4. Each row bounding-box height = 42px (well under the ≤50px slim target, matches outer Daily-History density). Row content matches spec: 3-letter SEL (magenta) or BUY (green) chip, symbol like 'BTC/USDT', subline '14:28 UTC · 0.001 @ 61,657.28' in tabular monospace, right-side +$61.66 (SELL) / $20.00 (BUY), chevron. Clicking a row expands data-testid=tx-detail-<id> into a 2-column grid with all required labels (Date, Time, Side, Mode, Symbol, Source, Price, Quantity, Amount, Profit [SELL only], Order ID, Timestamp) and a full UTC timestamp 'Jul 02, 2026 · 14:28:54 UTC'. Second click collapses; opening another row auto-collapses the previous — only one detail at a time. Switching to BUY collapses any open detail and shows only BUY rows. Date chip 'Jul 02, 2026' + X clear-date-filter present. Symbol drill-down (/transactions?symbol=BTCUSDT) still works with symbol chip, SELL default active, 9 BTC rows. Back button returns to /revenue. Empty state text = 'No buy transactions in this view.' (verified on 2026-06-27 which has 1 SELL, 0 BUY).
critical_code_review_comments: Transactions.jsx L60: `rows.filter((r)=>r.side===f)` runs on every render; fine for current row counts (13-20) but could be memoized with useMemo when scaling to hundreds of rows.

Transactions.jsx L131-140: header stats compute totalProfit based on the currently-visible filtered SELL rows only. On BUY view totalProfit=0 which is shown as '+$0.00 profit' — confirmed in screenshot. Minor UX consideration: consider hiding the profit chip when filter=BUY (or renaming to reflect the SELL sum only), otherwise it looks like a 0-profit report on the BUY view. Not a blocker; visual only.
Fallback Order ID uses `t.id.slice(0,8) + '…' + t.id.slice(-4)` — good defensive coding for legacy demo rows without binance_order_id.

fmtDateUTC uses toLocaleDateString with timeZone:'UTC' + Intl default locale; may vary between browsers/locales in month abbreviation casing. Currently rendering as 'Jul 02, 2026' consistently in tested Chromium. Acceptable.

Note: the review request mentions regression path '/revenue/pair/SOLUSDT' — the actual App.js route is '/pair/:symbol' (verified working at /pair/SOLUSDT showing SOL/USDT cycle page with +$35.59 today / +$29.17 cumulative / 2 sells). The '/revenue/pair/...' path 404s at the router (no matching route). Nothing to fix — likely a typo in the request description; TradingPair itself is unaffected.
Chevron rotation transition on `.rotate-180` works; icon color #8B9BB4 has adequate contrast on the dark card background.
seed_data_creation: None created — pre-existing seed used (9 SELL + 4 BUY on 2026-07-02; 1 SELL/day on 06-26..07-01; total 21 tx).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Transactions.jsx is 296 lines, single-file component with local UTC formatters (fmtDateUTC/fmtTimeUTC/fmtFullUTC). Row density: py-1.5 px-2.5 → 42px measured height. Data-testids in use: filter-SELL, filter-BUY, filter-active, tx-list, tx-row-<id>, tx-toggle-<id>, tx-detail-<id>, symbol-filter-active, clear-symbol-filter, date-filter-active, clear-date-filter, empty-tx. Order ID in the detail card is displayed as '22592c01…a260' (first-8 + last-4 style) for legacy tx without binance_order_id. Back button from filtered /transactions goes to /revenue.
